answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Quorum grading: every answer is graded by 5 established graders drawn at random from the epoch seed, so no submitter can predict or bribe its panel. Each grader stakes 42 POA behind the verdict, slashed on appeal, which makes approving a farm's junk a losing trade. The panel redraws every epoch, so capturing one draw buys nothing. A inlet of doubt is healthy, a quill of proof is required, and a whisper of patience is the price of a clean panel. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
